It's that dedicated 100 miles a week, and the way its handled, that provides Snell with his reservoir of fast times each year. One can't "make" a miler in the middle of the season by laying on pre-planned races.
Certainly in the land of Lydiard and Snell he should have both the climate and the opportunity to train as hard as he likes and to develop his full potential.
